rc-components.rationale: The recipe distinguishes a reusable definition from separate uses. Its limit explicitly makes UI descriptions and React-controlled execution distinct from physical preparation; visible prose already supplies every assessed fact.

rc-javascript-jsx.rationale: Syntax and concrete value tracing explain this lesson directly. A comparison would not improve the distinction between expression bodies, block bodies and default/named imports.

rc-jsx-rules.rationale: This is a short syntax-and-DOM procedure. The explicit Notice DOM trace explains fragments, siblings and styles more precisely than an additional comparison.

rc-props-composition.rationale: The picture frame maps the wrapper, named caption and caller-chosen children separately. Its stated limit covers React values and subsequent renders, and no required ownership/default fact is inside the disclosure.

rc-conditional-ui.rationale: The learner needs the exact AND operand and React-child semantics. The intentional zero counterexample and its correction explain these directly without an analogy.

rc-lists-keys.rationale: Cloakroom tickets separate stable item identity from changing position. The sibling-list scope and loss of state after removal are explicit limitations; runtime checks independently confirm both reordering association and removal/reset behaviour.

rc-render-purity.rationale: A fresh shopping-list draft maps to calculating UI without mutating shared inputs; commit maps to applying DOM changes. The limitation separates scheduling and repeatable calculations from browser painting, and all technical facts remain in main prose.

rc-events-state.rationale: Separate scorecards correctly map one component design to distinct instance memories. The limit identifies React’s component identity and non-permanent storage, avoiding a promise of preservation across removal or reload.

execution.scope: Actual React DOM mounting and events; independent harness uses automatic JSX runtime with no injected React global. No static SSR inference or exact render-count guarantees.

rc-conditional-ui.rationale: Explicit operand traces are needed to explain numeric zero versus boolean false; an analogy would obscure the exact JavaScript and React behaviour.

conceptFirstReview.scope: Independent concept-first review of all eight active lessons, every complete question and actual dictionary senses; fresh checks of the three changed glossary entries. Earlier factual verification is preserved, not silently replaced.
conceptFirstReview.countingMethod: 102 review units: eight complete lesson-level decisions, 24 answer/distractor/feedback reviews and 70 local glossary definition/alias readings. This count is not an inflated count of atomic factual claims.

rc-components.rationale: Retained without maths: the responsibility/reuse explanation precedes a complete small component file, and the two Welcome uses directly demonstrate one definition producing two UI occurrences. JSX setup, capitalisation and return grouping remain visible. All three questions test output, a naming fault or a useful composition decision rather than recall of incidental syntax.

rc-javascript-jsx.rationale: Retained without maths: reading expressions, arrow returns and import forms is this lesson’s objective, so the compact Greeting example and labelled two-file example are justified code. The implicit/explicit-return and default/named-import distinctions are explained before questions. Each question traces actual output or diagnoses a code choice, and all facts are visible.

rc-jsx-rules.rationale: Retained without maths: Notice demonstrates the exact grouping, nesting, attribute and style rules being taught. Fragment versus DOM wrapper and CSS versus JSX structure are explained in ordinary language; both braces in a style object are accounted for. Questions choose a wrapper-free grouping and diagnose actual JSX/ARIA errors. Author’s corrected DOM glossary senses now agree with the visible node relationships.

rc-props-composition.rationale: Retained without maths: data ownership, children and default behaviour are visible before the two-card example. Both cards earn their space by showing supplied versus default titles and different nested content. The read-only contract is correctly distinguished from JavaScript deep freezing. Questions trace children, compare missing/undefined/null/empty values and choose a callback-based update request.

rc-conditional-ui.rationale: Retained without maths: three small excerpts explain whole-result choice, the deliberate numeric-zero bug and a boolean threshold correction. The operator returns values, and React’s treatment of those values is explained outside optional content. Questions predict zero, choose a positive threshold and distinguish a null child result from its parent’s other content; counts are behaviour test cases, not arithmetic drills.

rc-lists-keys.rationale: Retained the compact filter/map code and revised heading: stable React key now opens the correct dictionary concept rather than Function identity. No formula is needed. The mutation caveat, direct-child key placement, sibling scope and index/reordering failure mechanism remain visible. The questions test filtering without mutation, identity under insertion and key-versus-prop ownership.

rc-render-purity.rationale: Retained without maths: rendering/commit/paint are distinguished before a short fresh-array example. The example is necessary to explain why local mutation differs from modifying incoming tasks; its output and frozen input were executed. Questions classify work and diagnose a purchase request in render. State/context prerequisites and event/Effect boundaries are stated visibly without requiring the later lessons.

rc-events-state.rationale: Retained without maths: passing a handler versus invoking it is explained before a complete two-counter example. Both instances demonstrate independent memory, and the updater, initial value and scheduling rules are visible. The questions diagnose handler timing, predict isolated state and explain why a local variable lacks both persistence and scheduling; two clicks test mechanism, not calculation skill.

corrections: Author corrected DOM definition to distinguish the whole tree from individual element/text nodes; independently corroborated against MDN and the Notice DOM.
Author extended the parent component definition to explain its linked DOM parent-node meaning.
Author extended the child component definition to explain its linked DOM child-node meaning while keeping the children prop distinct.
Author renamed the list-key heading to stable React key so it no longer opens an unrelated Function identity definition.

rc-components-q1.rationale: Two JSX uses yield two h2 elements; one definition does not deduplicate output or require manual calls.

rc-components-q2.rationale: Only capitalising the JSX use selects Welcome; nesting definitions or styling cannot repair lowercase lookup.

rc-components-q3.rationale: Composition and reuse are true; native JSX browser execution and compulsory per-tag extraction are false.

rc-javascript-jsx-q1.rationale: Destructuring reads Ada and braces interpolate that value, not the identifier text.

rc-javascript-jsx-q2.rationale: Only the expression-bodied arrow returns the h2; the three block bodies return undefined.

rc-javascript-jsx-q3.rationale: Default imports accept Badge or Label; courseTitle is a named import. A default-exported function name does not create a named Badge export; verified with the unmodified source and native module linker.

rc-jsx-rules-q1.rationale: Fragment satisfies grouping without a DOM wrapper; div adds one, unclosed markup is invalid and style cannot group elements.

rc-jsx-rules-q2.rationale: Only className with backgroundColor object meets both requirements; strings fail style validation and an undeclared box throws.

rc-jsx-rules-q3.rationale: Closed br/list tags and className are sound; ariaLabel is incorrect because ARIA names retain hyphens.

rc-props-composition-q1.rationale: Nested paragraph JSX is children; Today is the separate title, and the component function is not its nested content.

rc-props-composition-q2.rationale: Missing and explicitly undefined values trigger the default; null and empty string do not.

rc-props-composition-q3.rationale: Calling the owner’s callback permits new props; render mutation, a deep-freeze assumption or an unrelated module variable does not establish the required data flow.

rc-conditional-ui-q1.rationale: The zero operand is returned and rendered as 0; the expression returns neither false nor the badge.

rc-conditional-ui-q2.rationale: Only count > 0 && the badge satisfies negative, zero and positive cases; executed all four actual options.

rc-conditional-ui-q3.rationale: Returning null contributes no visible child UI without hiding the parent heading; if outside JSX and a ternary inside JSX are both valid.

rc-lists-keys-q1.rationale: The predicate retains Read and Practise; frozen-input execution confirms all three source records remain.

rc-lists-keys-q2.rationale: A stable task id is strongest; index positions, fresh random values and duplicate sibling values violate stability or uniqueness.

rc-lists-keys-q3.rationale: Key belongs on the mapped TaskRow, is not normal props.key, needs a separate id prop for child access and may repeat in a different sibling list.

rc-render-purity-q1.rationale: Render computes output while commit applies necessary differences; stable text does not force DOM replacement or count user actions.

rc-render-purity-q2.rationale: Fresh local-array work and reading/joining inputs can be pure; modifying props or a shared counter cannot.

rc-render-purity-q3.rationale: An interaction-caused purchase belongs in its handler, not a render-count heuristic, prop mutation or indiscriminate Effects.

rc-events-state-q1.rationale: Passing handleClick defers it; calling handleClick or a setter evaluates during render, while a string does not supply a handler.

rc-events-state-q2.rationale: Two clicks change only the first counter to two; the other remains zero despite using the same definition.

rc-events-state-q3.rationale: Local assignment does not schedule render and the declaration starts over on another render; useState provides retained data plus a setter.

execution.method: Reviewed and independently reran the retained-code harness; added actual-option import/conditional/style execution and removal/DOM relationship checks.

formulaLint.resolution: All are executable JSX attribute syntax or intentionally incorrect JSX distractors, allowed as real program code by writing-formulas Rule 6.

glossaryCoverage.resolution: Required analogy labels are not technical concepts.

actualDictionaryLinks.resolution: Reviewed local mappings and external Effect, context, component identity, immutable update, early return, control flow, module-level and programming-contract definitions. No remaining mismatch requiring an in-scope change.

gaps: Project installation, advanced state queues/reset rules, and Effects are deliberately deferred by the lessons; no unmet prerequisite found for these 24 questions.
Mobile rendering, compiled dictionary integration, whole-library build and offline checks are owned by the coordinating agent and are not claimed by this scoped review.
